summary: Regression smoke test after mobile yarn.lock regeneration. All three requested routes (/play, /courses, /start-round) load cleanly on the Expo web preview with expected content rendered and no red screen or page errors. Metro bundles 1384 modules with 0 errors. Only pre-existing benign React Native Web deprecation warnings (shadow*/textShadow*/pointerEvents) observed — unrelated to the dependency reinstall.

react_native_issues.issue: Non-blocking warnings: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow), 'textShadow*' deprecated (use textShadow), props.pointerEvents deprecated (use style.pointerEvents). Pre-existing, not caused by lockfile change.
